name: auth-flow-lock-screen
title: Auth Flow Lock Screen
description: A device-style lock screen with rolling clock digits over a layered dusk wallpaper. Unlocking opens a frosted PIN pad that accepts the keyboard, shakes on a wrong PIN, locks out with a countdown ring after too many tries, and lifts away with an opening shackle on success.
author: Hyperblur <hello@hyperblur.dev>
